report.summary: No contradictions found within the section; all claims are internally consistent and no external document context was provided to check for contradictions. Each claim is sound under the contradiction lens.

claims.claim: Ikarus is persistent in goals and evidence, not an unconstrained immortal chat.
claims.why: This claim defines Ikarus's nature. No contradictory claim found within the section. Without access to the full document, no external contradiction can be identified.

claims.claim: It compiles user intent into a typed MissionContract, creates an artifact DAG, selects stateless or explicitly versioned recipes, monitors budgets and attempts, and presents decisions and evidence.
claims.why: Enumerates Ikarus's functions. No internal contradiction; each action is distinct and compatible.

claims.claim: Coordination is artifact-first: MissionContract -> WorkItems -> Attempts -> Artifacts -> EvidencePacket
claims.why: Describes the coordination flow. No contradictory ordering found within the section.

claims.claim: Typed events and artifacts are authoritative.
claims.why: Establishes authority of typed events/artifacts. No contradictory claim within the section.

claims.claim: Chat is an interface, not the workflow database.
claims.why: Clarifies role of chat. No contradictory claim within the section.

claims.claim: Product memory (preferences, projects, explanations) and research adaptive memory (operators, priors, trial outcomes) are separate, versioned, provenance-bearing stores with explicit projection rules.
claims.why: Describes memory architecture. No contradictory claim within the section.
